recordingConsentShown.reason: 并入 recordingMode（壳无存值 = 未同意 = off，P0-11）+ setup_done.json；不再有第二把标记

screenPermissionRequested.reason: TCC 引导归壳（R2.2.3）：ShellSystem.swift PermissionsProbe.request 同名键

showMenuBarIcon.reason: D3：壳 Dock-only、菜单栏状态项退役（settings.menuBar 同判）

terminalApp.reason: 「在终端打开」的执行者是 server（open -a，§68.7）——偏好落 settings_overrides terminal_app

vaultAccessGranted.reason: Documents 授权按壳的 bundle id 记账（§68.13）：PermissionsProbe vault 探针同名键

controls.en: Run in the repo directory to see feature usage and health signals.
controls.zh: 在 repo 目录下运行，查看功能使用频率与健康信号。

controls.en: Stops every background service and removes the product; task history and keys are kept by default.
controls.zh: 停止全部后台服务并移除本产品；任务历史与密钥默认保留。
新版本 v{latest} 可用 — 一键更新

controls.en: Check and install in one click — downloads, verifies the signature, installs, and relaunches; no trip to GitHub. The install step asks for your admin password once (same as a manual install). Settings and task data stay on this Mac and survive the upgrade.
controls.zh: 检查并一键安装更新——自动下载、校验签名、安装并重启，无需去 GitHub。安装那一步会要一次管理员密码（和手动安装一样）。设置与任务数据都保留在本机，升级后原样可用。

controls.en: Check failed — GitHub API rate limit hit; it resets within the hour. Your network is fine.
controls.zh: 检查失败——GitHub 接口暂时限流，约一小时内自动恢复；你的网络没有问题。

controls.en: Check failed — network unavailable; try again later.
controls.zh: 检查失败——网络不可用，稍后再试。

controls.en: Automatic update checks are off — re-enable them on the Settings page.
controls.zh: 自动检查新版本已关闭——到「设置」页可重新开启。

controls.en: The last check got no answer ({r}) — hit Check now to retry.
controls.zh: 上次检查没有取得结果（{r}）——点「立即检查」重试。

controls.en:
Expected at: {script}
Update the product once (reinstall the .pkg or git pull) to restore it, or follow the Uninstall section of docs/INSTALL.md to remove things manually.
controls.zh:
预期位置：{script}
更新一次产品（重装 .pkg 或 git pull）即可补上，或按 docs/INSTALL.md 的「卸载」一节手动移除。
请手动在 Terminal 里运行：{shellCmd}
实时字幕（出错，见悬浮窗）

controls.en:
Failed to write the inbox action file: {error.localizedDescription}
The card is unchanged — please try again.
controls.zh:
写入 inbox 指令文件失败：{error.localizedDescription}
卡片保持原样，请稍后重试。

controls.en: The dropped text could not be written to the inbox — this capture was NOT recorded. Please try again.
controls.zh: 拖放的文字写入 inbox 失败，这条捕获没有被记录，请重试。

controls.en: Couldn't start the Q&A helper ({launchError}) — run a checkup on the Diagnostics page first.
controls.zh: 问答组件启动失败（{launchError}）——先到「诊断」页跑一次体检。

controls.en: No answer came back — hit Retry.
controls.zh: 没有得到回答——点「重试」再问一次。

controls.en: The AI didn't answer within 60 s — hit Retry.
controls.zh: AI 没有在 60 秒内回答——点「重试」再问一次。

controls.en: Ask anything about this product — why there are no new cards, how to switch recording modes… Answers are grounded in the product docs and this Mac's real state. Asking sends your question, the relevant doc excerpts and a machine-state summary to your AI engine (Anthropic); it runs in the background — no terminal window.
controls.zh: 关于这个产品的任何问题——为什么没有新卡片、怎么换录制模式……回答基于产品文档和这台 Mac 的真实状态。提问会把问题、相关文档摘录和机器状态摘要发送给你的 AI 引擎（Anthropic）；在后台完成，不弹终端。
思考中… 已 {model.elapsed} 秒（最多 60 秒）

controls.en: Helpful (logs an anonymous event that uploads with usage stats; your question text is attached only while Settings' "Upload the text I type" is on — off by default)
controls.zh: 有帮助（记一条匿名事件，随使用统计上传；问题文本仅当设置里「上传我输入的文本」开启时附带，默认关）

controls.en: Not helpful (logs an anonymous event that uploads with usage stats; your question text is attached only while Settings' "Upload the text I type" is on — off by default)
controls.zh: 没帮助（记一条匿名事件，随使用统计上传；问题文本仅当设置里「上传我输入的文本」开启时附带，默认关）

controls.en: Ask is disabled in config.yaml (ask.enabled: false).
controls.zh: 问问助手已在 config.yaml 里关闭（ask.enabled: false）。

controls.en: The AI engine is not connected — connect it first to ask questions.
controls.zh: AI 引擎未连接——先接入 AI 引擎才能提问。

controls.en: Overall feedback; use Select first to target cards
controls.zh: 对整体提建议；先「选择」卡片可针对所选卡

controls.en: Not-urgent items park here — nothing runs on its own, nothing expires
controls.zh: 不着急的事会先停在这里——不会自动执行，也永不过期

controls.en: Nothing needs your decision. Capture a thought in the box above
controls.zh: 没有等你拍板的事。想到什么，直接在上面输入框里说一句

controls.en: Nothing needs your decision. Capture a thought in the box above
controls.zh: 没有等你拍板的事。想到什么，直接在上面输入框里说一句

controls.en: Nothing running — approve a proposal to start
controls.zh: 没有正在执行的任务。批准一个提案，AI 就开始干活

controls.en: Nothing running — approve a proposal, or type above to run one now
controls.zh: 没有正在执行的任务。批准一个提案，或在上面输入框里直接开跑

controls.en: No drafts waiting for your review
Skip AI analysis — pick a primary and merge now (not reversible)
controls.zh: 跳过 AI 分析，钦定主卡直接合并（不可撤销）

controls.en: Threads that are truly over — ones you marked done for good, plus auto-sealed cold deliveries. Sealed = excluded from matching, so later mentions open a fresh card instead of re-raising this one. Press "Put back" any time to return one to its previous lane.
controls.zh: 彻底结束、封存的线程（你点的永久完成 + 自动封存的冷交付）。封存=不再参与匹配，后续相关信息会开新卡而不是回锅这张。可随时「放回看板」回到原状态列。
🗄 永久性完成 · done for good

controls.en: Click to copy · double-click to run in terminal
controls.zh: 单击复制 · 双击在终端运行

controls.en: Rename the board display name (internal title unchanged; old names stay searchable)
controls.zh: 改看板显示名（内部标题不变，改过的旧名仍可搜索）

controls.en: Folded into the wrong card? Split it out (the origin line is kept)
controls.zh: 这条信息不该折在这张卡里？拆出去单独成卡（原记录保留）

controls.en: One line — run it now (skips proposal)…
controls.zh: 一句话，直接开跑（跳过提案）…

controls.en: One sentence — AI researches and proposes…
controls.zh: 一句话，AI 来研究并提案…

controls.en: Runs now — skips the proposal & cost preview; the result still lands in Review
controls.zh: 直接开跑：跳过提案与费用预估，成果仍进「待验收」

controls.en: ↩ send · ⇧↩ newline · Esc dismiss · ⌘V pastes images
controls.zh: ↩ 发送 · ⇧↩ 换行 · Esc 退出 · ⌘V 可贴图

controls.en: The clipboard also holds an image: click 📎 or press ⌥⌘V
controls.zh: 剪贴板里还有图片：点 📎 或 ⌥⌘V 贴图

controls.en: ⌘V pastes images (up to {PastedImagesModel.maxCount}; kept on this Mac); ⌥⌘V force-pastes
controls.zh: 可 ⌘V 粘贴图片（最多 {PastedImagesModel.maxCount} 张，仅保存在本机），或按 ⌥⌘V 强制贴图
把剪贴板中的图片贴进来（⌥⌘V）
永久完成（封存，不再提示）

controls.en: The Gmail radar is on but its scheduler isn't installed
controls.zh: Gmail 雷达开着，但后台调度没装上

controls.en: The Slack radar is on but its scheduler isn't installed
controls.zh: Slack 雷达开着，但后台调度没装上

controls.en: The switch is on, but launchd has no job for it (likely removed by an upgrade while it was off) — one click reinstalls it in place.
controls.zh: 开关是开的，但 launchd 里没有它的调度任务（多半是关着时升级被卸载了）——点一下原地装回去。

controls.en: The Gmail radar is on but not set up
controls.zh: Gmail 雷达开着但还没配好

controls.en: The switch is on but the app password or address is missing — add it so the radar can scan.
controls.zh: 开关开着，但缺应用密码或邮箱地址——补上它雷达才能开始扫。

controls.en: The Gmail fetch command is failing
Mail comes via your custom fetch command (gmail_fetch_command), and it's erroring or emitting output the radar can't read — check that command in Gmail settings.
controls.zh: 邮件走的是你的自定义抓取命令（gmail_fetch_command），它在报错或输出不是雷达能读的格式——去 Gmail 设置里检查那条命令。

controls.en: An app password is saved but the radar can't log in — the password likely expired or the address is off.
controls.zh: 存了应用密码，但雷达没法用它登录——多半是密码过期或邮箱地址没填对。

controls.en: A token is saved but Slack rejected it — copy the User OAuth Token (starts with xoxp-) again.
controls.zh: 存了 token，但 Slack 拒绝了它——重新复制 User OAuth Token（xoxp- 开头）再试。

controls.en: No token yet, so the fallback uses claude's Slack MCP — but it isn't registered in the CLI. Save a token or add the Slack MCP.
controls.zh: 还没存 token，兜底走 claude 的 Slack MCP——但 CLI 里没配这个 MCP。存个 token 或加上 Slack MCP 都行。

controls.en: Recording is on but no notes are being made
controls.zh: 录制开着，但没在生成笔记

controls.en: The capture engine isn't running, so nothing is captured and no notes reach the vault. Restart it in place.
controls.zh: 录制引擎没在跑，屏幕内容没被抓下来，也就没有笔记进 vault。原地重启引擎试试。
屏幕录制权限被收回了

controls.en: The engine runs, but macOS revoked Screen Recording (an OS update/reinstall silently drops it) — nothing gets captured.
controls.zh: 引擎在跑，但 macOS 收回了「屏幕录制」授权（系统更新/重装会静默失效）——录不到任何东西。

controls.en: Recording is on but no new notes appear
controls.zh: 录制开着，但 vault 里没有新笔记

controls.en: A step in the screen→note chain isn't firing (export/cleanup/ingest). The dependency check pinpoints which one.
controls.zh: 屏幕→笔记这条链有一环没通（导出/清洗/ingest）。过一遍依赖检查能定位到具体哪一步。

controls.en: The scheduled job has no API key
controls.zh: 定时任务没有 API key

controls.en: Capture works, but turning captures into notes calls claude — and the scheduled job can't read an Anthropic API key.
controls.zh: 截图能录，但把截图变成笔记要调用 claude，而定时任务读不到 Anthropic API key。
截图→笔记这条链在报错

controls.en: A key exists, but claude failed while processing a note (error/timeout/unparseable output). Full logs are in the dependency check.
controls.zh: 有 API key，但 claude 处理笔记时失败了（模型报错/超时/输出无法解析）。依赖检查里有完整日志。
还没指定 Obsidian 目录

controls.en: Recording is on but no vault folder is set for the notes — point to one so the pipeline has somewhere to land.
controls.zh: 录制开着，但没告诉助手笔记该放哪个 vault 目录——先指定它，链路才能落地。
忽略这张卡（问题还在会重新出现）
输入 确认 或 go

controls.en: What's off / could be better. On send, your feedback text and the selected cards' title snapshots are uploaded to the maintainer to improve the product (even with anonymous stats off) — avoid sensitive details. Pasted images stay on this Mac and are never uploaded.
controls.zh: 说说哪里不对 / 可以更好。发送后，建议全文与所选卡片的标题快照会上传给维护者用于改进产品（即使你关闭了匿名统计）——请勿包含敏感信息。粘贴的图片只保存在本机，不会上传。

controls.en: Also publish to the public GitHub suggestion tracker
controls.zh: 同时公开到 GitHub 建议跟踪表

controls.en: Public — visible to anyone; leave out anything sensitive.
controls.zh: 公开后任何人可见，别含敏感信息。

controls.en: Your answer goes back into the original session (context kept); the task continues.
controls.zh: 答案会送回原 session（上下文保留），任务继续跑。

controls.en: The pasted images could not be saved (disk space or encoding issue); only your text was submitted.
controls.zh: 粘贴的图片未能保存（磁盘空间或编码问题），已只提交文字部分。

controls.en: The pasted images could not be saved (disk space or encoding issue); nothing was submitted — please try again.
controls.zh: 粘贴的图片未能保存（磁盘空间或编码问题），建议未提交——请重试。

controls.en: Merged into the request's plan/notes; the card stays in Proposals awaiting your approval.
controls.zh: 会并入需求的 plan/notes，卡片留在提案列等你批准。

controls.en:
Feedback returns to the original session (context kept); the task goes back to running.
Send empty = the AI re-checks itself against the definition of done.
controls.zh:
反馈会送回原 session（上下文保留），任务回到运行中继续改。
留空直接发送 = 让 AI 对照「怎样算办完」自查并改进。

controls.en: What's missing / what to change… (may be empty)
controls.zh: 还差什么 / 要改什么…（可留空）
第 {index + 1} 组 · 保持独立：

controls.en: Suggest merging the secondary into the primary
controls.zh: 建议合并：副卡并入主卡

controls.en: Suggest linking as an improvement of the primary
controls.zh: 建议挂为主卡的改进卡
建议关闭副卡（进回收站）
建议分成 {k} 组分别合并

controls.en: Pick one card to keep as the primary; the rest fold into it.
controls.zh: 选一张作为主卡保留，其余全部并入它。

controls.en: Secondaries stop running and become “merged” — this cannot be undone. Their sources and deliverables are kept on the primary.
controls.zh: 副卡会停止运行、进入「已合并」——这一步不可撤销。它们的来源与交付物会保留在主卡上。

controls.en: Saved to the queue — processed once the pipeline is running
controls.zh: 已保存到队列，pipeline 启动后开始处理
已提交，AI 分析中（通常 2-3 分钟）
AI 研究中…（补全上下文、生成提案）

controls.en: No need to run this card?
📄 Drafts land in: your-workbench (documents only, no code touched)
controls.zh: 📄 草稿落点: your-workbench（只出文档，不动任何代码）

controls.en: 🟠 Modify existing: {name} (draft PR only, main branch untouched)
controls.zh: 🟠 修改现有: {name}（只提 draft PR，不动主分支）

controls.en: You accepted this before — new info arrived
controls.zh: 你之前验收过这件事，来了新信息

controls.en: This came up {r} times — restatements were merged into this card
controls.zh: 这件事被提起过 {r} 次，重述已合并进这张卡

controls.en: {sm} duplicate card(s) were silently folded in; each fold note in the details can be split back out
controls.zh: {sm} 张重复卡片已静默并入这张卡；详情里的并入记录可一键拆回独立卡片

controls.en: Launch a temporary Claude session to review this lane's backlog: it judges each proposal (keep / stale / duplicate), confirms with you in conversation, and delivers a keep/drop/merge recommendation list. The session appears in Running — join anytime; it never modifies cards directly.
controls.zh: 启动一个临时 Claude 会话审阅本列全部积压提案：逐张判断仍值得做/过时/重复，和你对话确认后交付一份保留/丢弃/合并建议清单（会话出现在运行中列，可随时打开参与；它不会直接改动任何卡片）

controls.en: No backlog in Proposals — come back when cards pile up
controls.zh: 提案列没有积压——有卡片堆起来时再用

controls.en: dashboard.json: skipped {db.decodeDrops.count} corrupt row(s), the rest render normally:
controls.zh: dashboard.json 有 {db.decodeDrops.count} 行损坏已跳过（其余照常显示）:

controls.en: Your input was merged into {r.req}{name} (no new card filed)
controls.zh: 刚才的输入已并入 {r.req}{name}（没有建新卡）

controls.en: "{String(c.text.prefix(20}))" did not start — the backend may not be running (check actd)
controls.zh: 「{String(c.text.prefix(20}))」任务没有开始——后台可能没在跑（检查 actd）

controls.en: Analysis is slower than usual — the card should still appear; if it never does, open the Dependencies page and check state/actd.log
controls.zh: 分析比平时慢，卡片稍后会自动出现；一直没有就打开「依赖检查」页并查看 state/actd.log

controls.en: Research proposal for "{String(entry.summary.prefix(20}))" timed out — try again
Backend timed out — the card is interactive again
controls.zh: 后台响应超时，卡片已恢复可操作

controls.en: "{label}" was submitted but the backend never confirmed — check that actd is running
controls.zh: 「{label}」已提交但后台超时未确认，请检查 actd 是否在运行

controls.en: Split-into-card timed out — the note is unchanged, try again (check that actd is running)
controls.zh: 「拆成新卡」超时未生效，原备注未变化，请重试（检查 actd 是否在运行）

controls.en: Comment timed out before merging — the card is unchanged, try again (check that actd is running)
controls.zh: 修改意见超时未合并，卡片未变化，请重试（检查 actd 是否在运行）

controls.en: Merge analysis request timed out — no suggestion card appeared, try again (check that actd is running)
controls.zh: 合并分析请求超时，后台未生成建议卡，请重试（检查 actd 是否在运行）

controls.en: Merge-suggestion action timed out — the card is interactive again (check that actd is running)
controls.zh: 合并建议操作超时，卡片已恢复可操作（检查 actd 是否在运行）

controls.en: Force-merge never confirmed — nothing changed, try again (check that actd is running)
controls.zh: 强制合并未确认，卡片未变化，请重试（检查 actd 是否在运行）

controls.en: Rename timed out — the card name is unchanged, try again (check that actd is running)
controls.zh: 改名超时未确认，卡片名字未变化，请重试（检查 actd 是否在运行）

controls.en: Answer timed out unconfirmed — the card still needs input, try again (check that actd is running)
controls.zh: 回答超时未确认，卡片仍在「需输入」，请重试（检查 actd 是否在运行）

controls.en: Restore timed out — the card is back in the trash, try again (check that actd is running)
controls.zh: 恢复超时，卡片仍在回收站，可重试（检查 actd 是否在运行）

controls.en: Discard & re-propose timed out — the card is still in Running, try again (check that actd is running)
controls.zh: 退回提案超时，卡片仍在运行中列，可重试（检查 actd 是否在运行）

controls.en: Back-to-review timed out — the card is still in Done for now, try again (check that actd is running)
controls.zh: 退回待验收超时，卡片仍在「阶段性完成」列，可重试（检查 actd 是否在运行）

controls.en: Put back timed out — the card is still in Done for good, try again (check that actd is running)
controls.zh: 放回看板超时，卡片仍在「永久性完成」区，可重试（检查 actd 是否在运行）

controls.en: Stop-to-review timed out — the card is still in Running, try again (check that actd is running)
controls.zh: 去待验收超时，卡片仍在运行中列，可重试（检查 actd 是否在运行）

controls.en: Restoring — the card returns to its previous lane
controls.zh: 恢复中，卡片将回到原状态列

controls.en: Putting back — the card returns to its previous lane
controls.zh: 放回看板中，卡片将回到原状态列
停止中，卡片将回到提案列
停止中，卡片将去待验收
退回中，卡片将回到待验收

controls.en: No acceptance criteria defined — judge manually
controls.zh: 该任务未定义验收标准，请自行判断

controls.en: Click to copy the command · double-click opens the session in Terminal
controls.zh: 单击复制指令 · 双击在终端打开会话

controls.en: Saved to the queue — runs once the pipeline is up
controls.zh: 已保存到队列，pipeline 启动后直接开跑

controls.en: Submitted — running it now (skipped proposal), queued for dispatch…
controls.zh: 已提交，直接开跑（跳过提案），排队派发中…

controls.en: Discard & re-propose = throw away this run and start over; Keep for review = keep what it made and I'll check it
controls.zh: 退回提案＝丢弃这次结果重来；去待验收＝留下它做的，我来检查

controls.en: Click to copy the command · double-click opens the session in Terminal
controls.zh: 单击复制指令 · 双击在终端打开会话

controls.en: Fix with AI failed to launch:
controls.zh: 让 AI 修启动失败：

controls.en: Paused — nothing is captured or billed
controls.zh: 已暂停 — 未在采集，也不计费
麦克风音频格式转换失败
找不到可捕获的显示器

controls.en: Doubao speech credential is invalid or the streaming-ASR service is not activated — click 检测 in 设置 → Live captions to diagnose
controls.zh: 豆包语音凭证无效或未开通流式语音识别——去 设置→实时字幕 点「检测」排查

controls.en: On-device speech recognition does not support the selected language on this Mac
controls.zh: 这台 Mac 的本地语音识别不支持所选语言

controls.en: On-device recognizer audio format negotiation failed
controls.zh: 本地识别音频格式协商失败

controls.en: Ark API key is invalid — translation paused (captions unaffected)
controls.zh: Ark API Key 无效——翻译暂停（字幕不受影响）
翻译请求失败（HTTP {http.statusCode}），字幕不受影响

controls.en: the server's first frame was unparseable
controls.zh: 服务器返回了无法解析的首帧

controls.en: No Doubao speech credential yet — paste one in 设置 → Live captions (personal accounts qualify; 20 free hours)
controls.zh: 还没有豆包语音凭证——去 设置→实时字幕 粘贴（个人实名可开通，送 20 小时）

controls.en: Apple on-device recognition needs macOS 26 or later
controls.zh: Apple 本地识别需要 macOS 26 及以上

controls.en: No usable engine: add a Doubao speech API key (设置 → Live captions), or upgrade to macOS 26 for Apple on-device recognition
controls.zh: 没有可用的识别引擎：加一个豆包语音 API Key（设置→实时字幕），或升级到 macOS 26 用 Apple 本地识别

controls.en: Missing Screen Recording permission — cannot hear system audio
controls.zh: 缺「屏幕录制」权限，听不到系统声音

controls.en: Microphone access denied — enable it in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone
controls.zh: 麦克风权限被拒——去 系统设置→隐私与安全性→麦克风 打开

controls.en: — listening on the other source for now

controls.zh: 正在下载本地语言模型（只需一次）…

controls.en: The Apple on-device engine does captions only — translation needs the Doubao online engine
controls.zh: Apple 本地引擎只出字幕，不翻译——翻译需要豆包在线引擎

controls.en: No Ark API key yet — translation needs a separate Ark console key (not the speech key)
controls.zh: 还没有 Ark API Key——翻译要单独的 Ark 控制台 Key（和语音 Key 不是同一个）

controls.en: npx (screenpipe engine runs via npx — no separate install; missing? brew install node)
controls.zh: npx（screenpipe 引擎经 npx 自动运行，无需单独安装；缺失则 brew install node）

controls.en: CGPreflightScreenCaptureAccess() (without it the engine exits instantly, capturing nothing)
controls.zh: CGPreflightScreenCaptureAccess()（未授权时引擎启动即退出、录不到任何内容）
已授权（「屏幕+音频」转写可用）

controls.en: not granted — Screen + Audio mode can't transcribe
controls.zh: 未授权——「屏幕+音频」模式录不到语音

controls.en: not granted (not needed in the current mode; grant before switching to Screen + Audio)
controls.zh: 未授权（当前模式不需要；切「屏幕+音频」前先授权）

controls.en: claude executable (headless auth via Anthropic API key; no login needed)
controls.zh: claude 可执行文件（headless 认证走 Anthropic API key，无需登录）

controls.en: No probe data yet — wait for the next scheduled run (~30 min); if it never appears, rerun the installer (updates the cron line)
controls.zh: 还没有探测数据——等下一次定时运行（约 30 分钟）；一直没有就重跑一遍安装（会更新定时任务）

controls.en: Last probe {Int(age / 3600})h ago — the scheduled jobs may have stopped (run Diagnostics)
controls.zh: 最近一次探测在 {Int(age / 3600}) 小时前——定时任务可能停跑了（先查「诊断」）

controls.en: macOS blocks the scheduled jobs from reading {probe.path} — captures never become notes. Click Grant and follow the steps
controls.zh: macOS 挡住了定时任务读取 {probe.path}——屏幕记录不会变成笔记。点「去授权」按提示给 cron 开「完全磁盘访问」

controls.en: Diagnostics produced no output (exit {code2}) — check that install.sh exists at the repo root
controls.zh: 诊断没有产生输出（exit {code2}）——检查 install.sh 是否存在于 repo 根目录

controls.en: All wheels must be on before the car runs.
up to ~1-2 min (includes one live claude call)
controls.zh: 最长约 1-2 分钟（含一次真实 claude 调用）

controls.en: {fails} check(s) failed — each has its own button
controls.zh: {fails} 项未通过——每条都有对应按钮

controls.en: A quick diagnostic auto-runs when something looks broken; this button runs the full version (one live claude call).
controls.zh: 发现异常时会自动运行一次快速诊断；这个按钮跑完整版（含一次真实 claude 调用）。
目录里没有笔记（去开录制/授权）

controls.en: scheduled job has no API key (add one)
controls.zh: 定时任务没 API key（去填）
截图→笔记链报错（看依赖检查）
Slack 兜底没连（去连接 Slack）
找不到模板 {template}——repo 不完整？

controls.en: The claude CLI is not installed — the assistant cannot research or execute any card
controls.zh: claude 命令行没装好——助手无法研究或执行任何卡片

controls.en: This Mac has more than one claude CLI and the background service is using an outdated copy — update or remove the old one, then re-run the installer
controls.zh: 这台机器上有多个 claude 命令，后台服务在用过旧的那个——更新或删掉旧版，再重跑一次安装

controls.en: The AI API key is invalid or expired — re-paste one in Settings
controls.zh: AI 的 API key 无效或过期——去设置页重新粘贴一个

controls.en: Node.js is missing — the recording engine cannot start
controls.zh: 缺少 Node.js——录制引擎无法启动

controls.en: The recording engine is not running — nothing on screen is being captured
controls.zh: 录制引擎没有在运行——屏幕内容不会被记录

controls.en: The recording engine is downloading for the first time (~1-3 min) — nothing to do; recording starts automatically when it finishes
controls.zh: 录制引擎首次下载中（约 1-3 分钟）——不用做任何事，下载完会自动开始录制

controls.en: The recording engine stopped unexpectedly — click Restart engine; if it keeps happening, check the engine log lines below
controls.zh: 录制引擎意外停了——点「重启引擎」再试；反复失败就看下面的引擎日志

controls.en: Screen + Audio needs ffmpeg, which this Mac does not have — install it (brew install ffmpeg) or switch back to Screen Only
controls.zh: 「屏幕+音频」需要 ffmpeg，这台电脑上还没有——装一个（brew install ffmpeg）或切回「仅屏幕」

controls.en: macOS revoked the Screen Recording permission (common after a macOS update or app reinstall) — grant it once more to resume
controls.zh: 「屏幕录制」授权被 macOS 收回了（系统更新或重装应用后常见）——重新授权一次即可恢复

controls.en: A background service is not loaded — its work has stopped
controls.zh: 一个后台服务没有装载——它负责的工作停了

controls.en: The Python the background services run cannot read the project folder (macOS grants file access per program, and background jobs do not inherit your terminal's grant) — re-running the installer picks one that can
controls.zh: 后台服务用的那个 Python 读不到项目文件夹（macOS 按程序单独授权，后台任务不继承终端的权限）——重跑一次安装器会换一个能读的

controls.en: The background auto-deploy job cannot read the external volume the project lives on (macOS grants file access per program, and background jobs do not inherit your terminal's grant) — grant Full Disk Access to the Python it runs; the exact path is in doctor's launchd volume access row
controls.zh: 后台自动部署任务读不到项目所在的外置盘（macOS 按程序单独授权，后台任务不继承终端的权限）——给它用的那个 Python 授「完全磁盘访问」，路径见 doctor 的 launchd volume access 行

controls.en: The scheduled jobs are not installed — screen captures never become notes or cards
controls.zh: 定时任务没有安装——屏幕记录不会变成笔记和卡片

controls.en: macOS is blocking the scheduled jobs (no Full Disk Access) — notes are silently lost
controls.zh: 定时任务被 macOS 挡住了（缺「完全磁盘访问」）——笔记会静默丢失

controls.en: Background installs cannot rewrite the scheduled jobs (macOS blocks crontab — the launchd session has no Full Disk Access) — grant Full Disk Access to the daemon Python once, then bash install.sh; a terminal run proving it works proves nothing (Terminal has its own grant)
controls.zh: 后台安装改不了定时任务表（macOS 挡住了 crontab——launchd 会话缺「完全磁盘访问」）——给守护 Python 开一次完全磁盘访问再跑 bash install.sh；在终端里跑通不算数（Terminal 自带权限）

controls.en: The background service stopped updating data — the board shows old content
controls.zh: 后台服务停止更新数据——看板显示的是旧内容

controls.en: The claude binary the background service launches cannot read the task folder (macOS grants disk access per executable; launchd-spawned claude has no Full Disk Access and the folder sits on an external volume or in Documents/Desktop/Downloads — claude's own "low max file descriptors" guess is wrong) — System Settings → Privacy & Security → Full Disk Access: add the claude path named by doctor's `launchd claude` row (the stable copy install.sh maintains; one grant survives claude updates), or move the task folder under your home on the boot volume; then Stop → Discard & re-propose → approve the card again
controls.zh: 后台服务里的 claude 读不到任务目录（macOS 按可执行文件授磁盘权限，launchd 起的 claude 没有「完全磁盘访问」，任务目录又在外置卷或 Documents/Desktop/Downloads 里；claude 自己报的「low max file descriptors」是猜错的）——系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 完全磁盘访问，加入 doctor `launchd claude` 行点名的那个 claude 路径（install.sh 维护的稳定副本，授一次即跨 claude 更新有效），或把任务目录搬到启动盘的家目录下；然后把卡「停止 → 退回提案」再批准

controls.en: The background service ran out of open files (launchd's default soft limit is 256; the error reads EMFILE / too many open files) — re-run the installer (bash install.sh) so every agent carries a higher soft limit, then approve the card again
controls.zh: 后台服务的打开文件数耗尽（launchd 默认软上限 256；错误里写着 EMFILE / too many open files）——重跑一次安装器（bash install.sh）让每个后台服务带上更高的软上限，再重新批准这张卡

controls.en: claude has not accepted the bypass-permissions disclaimer on this machine yet — run `claude --dangerously-skip-permissions` once in a terminal and accept it, then background dispatch can start
controls.zh: claude 还没在这台机器上接受过「跳过权限确认」的免责声明——在终端里手动跑一次 `claude --dangerously-skip-permissions` 并接受，后台派发才能启动

controls.en: The background service process is alive but its heartbeat stopped (the loop is no longer running) — force-restart it: launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/com.zelin.aiassistant.actd
controls.zh: 后台服务进程还活着，但已经停止心跳（不再跑循环）——强制重启它：launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/com.zelin.aiassistant.actd

controls.en: A retired background service is still loaded in launchd (the repo no longer ships its template) — re-run the installer to unload it (bash install.sh), or launchctl bootout it by hand
controls.zh: 有已退役的后台服务还在 launchd 里运行（仓库里已没有它的模板）——重跑一次安装器把它卸掉（bash install.sh），或手动 launchctl bootout

controls.en: The model chosen in Settings is unavailable — every dispatch will fail; in Settings → Models switch back to "follow Claude Code" or pick a canonical id
controls.zh: 设置里选的模型不可用——派工会全部失败；去设置页「模型」改回「跟随 Claude Code 全局」或换一个 canonical id

controls.en: The board server does not answer on its port — the web board and the shell app have nothing to connect to; quit any hand-started `python3 -m server` / old shell, then launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/com.zelin.aiassistant.server (bash install.sh if never installed)
controls.zh: 看板 server 没在端口上答话——web 看板和壳 app 连不上；先退掉手动起的 `python3 -m server` / 旧壳，再 launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/com.zelin.aiassistant.server（没装则 bash install.sh）

controls.en: The deploy could not rebuild the web board: node lacks Full Disk Access in the launchd session (daemons upgraded, board still old) — grant the node binary Full Disk Access, or run bash install.sh once from a terminal
controls.zh: 自动部署没能重建 web 看板：node 在 launchd 会话里缺「完全磁盘访问」（守护进程已升级，看板还是旧的）——给 node 二进制开完全磁盘访问，或在终端里跑一次 bash install.sh

controls.en: The config file is broken — every component fell back to defaults
controls.zh: 配置文件写坏了——所有组件都退回默认设置

controls.en: Network trouble — it will retry automatically
controls.zh: 网络问题——稍后会自动重试

controls.en: "Grant…" copies {cronBinary} to the clipboard and opens the Full Disk Access pane. Then: click ➕ → press ⌘⇧G → ⌘V to paste → Return → select cron → toggle it on. This row turns green after the next scheduled run (within ~30 min).
controls.zh: 点「去授权」会把 {cronBinary} 复制到剪贴板并打开「完全磁盘访问」面板。然后：点 ➕ → 按 ⌘⇧G → ⌘V 粘贴 → 回车 → 选中 cron → 开启开关。下次定时任务运行（约 30 分钟内）后这一行会自动变绿。

controls.en: Service restarted but data still isn't updating — try "Fix with AI" or view the log
controls.zh: 后台服务已重启，但数据还没更新——点「让 AI 修」深挖，或查看日志

controls.en: Repair session opened in Terminal — just follow the AI
controls.zh: 已在 Terminal 打开修复会话——跟着 AI 走即可

controls.en: Data generated {max(1, Int(age / 60})) min ago — actd may be down
controls.zh: 数据生成于 {max(1, Int(age / 60})) 分钟前，actd 可能未运行

controls.en: Data {mins} min stale — the background service may be slow or just stopped
controls.zh: 数据 {mins} 分钟没更新——后台服务可能变慢或刚停止

controls.en: Card actions still land in the queue and apply once the service recovers.
controls.zh: 卡片操作仍会写入队列，后台服务恢复后照常生效。

controls.en: Background service failed {n} passes in a row — processing has likely stalled
controls.zh: 后台服务连续 {n} 轮处理失败——数据可能停止更新

controls.en: The service is alive but every pass crashes. "View log" and search for loop pass FAILED; this clears itself once passes recover.
controls.zh: 服务还在运行但每一轮都崩溃。点「查看日志」搜 loop pass FAILED 看堆栈；恢复后此提示自动消失。

controls.en: Background service down: data {mins} min stale
controls.zh: 后台服务已停止：数据 {mins} 分钟没更新

controls.en: Radars still report — only the main service is down. "Fix now" restarts it in place.
controls.zh: 雷达仍在上报——只有主后台服务停了。点「一键修复」原地重启它。

controls.en: No pipeline output at all — press "Fix now" first; if that fails, run the dependency check.
controls.zh: 整条链路都没有输出——先点「一键修复」，仍不行就过一遍依赖检查。

controls.en: Restarting the service and waiting for fresh data (up to 15 s)…
controls.zh: 正在重启后台服务并等待数据更新（最多 15 秒）…
已恢复 ✓ 数据重新更新了

controls.en: Board health banner: background service down; one-click repair failed:
controls.zh: 看板健康横幅：后台服务已停止；一键修复失败：

controls.en: The background service hasn't produced data yet
controls.zh: 后台服务还没写出数据

controls.en: This happens on a fresh install or when the service isn't running. "Start service" launches it in place.
controls.zh: 首次安装或服务未启动时会这样。点「启动后台服务」原地拉起它。

controls.en: Starting and waiting for the first data…
controls.zh: 正在启动并等待首份数据…
实时字幕（出错，见悬浮窗）
打开系统设置 → 屏幕录制

controls.en: Not recording — missing Screen Recording permission
controls.zh: 未在录制 — 缺「屏幕录制」权限

controls.en: Not recording — ffmpeg is missing (Screen + Audio needs it)
controls.zh: 未在录制 — 缺 ffmpeg（「屏幕+音频」需要）

controls.en: Not recording — the engine stopped unexpectedly (see Recording page)
controls.zh: 未在录制 — 引擎意外停了（详见录制页）

controls.en: ffmpeg is missing (brew install ffmpeg, then switch again)
controls.zh: 缺 ffmpeg（brew install ffmpeg 装好后再切一次）

controls.en: {label(forMode: failed}) could not start — {cause}; reverted to {label(forMode: kept}) and recording continues
controls.zh: 「{label(forMode: failed})」没能开启——{cause}；已退回「{label(forMode: kept})」继续录制

controls.en: Screen Recording is now granted — the engine restarted automatically
controls.zh: 屏幕权限已生效，录制引擎已自动重启
已有 ingest 在运行，本次跳过

controls.en: macOS ties this permission to the app's signature; an OS update or reinstall changes it, so the old grant silently stops working — nothing you did wrong. Recording resumes automatically once re-granted.
controls.zh: macOS 按应用签名识别授权；系统更新或重装应用会改变签名，旧授权就静默失效——不是你操作错了。重新授权后录制会自动恢复。

controls.en: Cause: macOS hasn't granted this app Screen Recording yet (grant once; recording then auto-starts with the app).
controls.zh: 原因：macOS 还没把「屏幕录制」权限授给本 App（授权一次即可，之后开 App 自动录制）。

controls.en: The recording button at the top-right of the menu-bar panel can switch modes anytime.
controls.zh: 菜单栏面板右上角的录制按钮可随时切换。
新版本 v{upd.latest} 可用 — 一键更新

controls.en: Open the app to see the board
controls.zh: 打开 App 查看看板

controls.en: Reverted to the previous recording mode
controls.zh: 已退回原来的录制模式

controls.en: The assistant lives in the menu bar. Click the icon for proposal cards; the capture field on top takes a one-line task anytime.
controls.zh: 助手住在菜单栏。点图标看提案卡片,顶部输入框随时捕获一句话任务。
欢迎使用 Zelin's AI Assistant

controls.en: This page sets up the system permissions in one place; statuses refresh live, and you can reopen it anytime from the menu ("Permissions Checkup").
controls.zh: 这一页帮你把需要的系统授权一次配齐;状态实时刷新,之后随时可从菜单「权限体检」再打开。

controls.en: No audio is recorded. Voice transcription (Screen + Audio) can be enabled separately later in Settings → Recording; this choice can be changed anytime.
controls.zh: 不录音频。语音转写(屏幕+音频)之后可在「设置 → 录制」里单独打开;这里的选择也随时可改。

controls.en: Visible on-screen text is captured into your local knowledge base; audio can only be enabled explicitly in Settings → Recording.
controls.zh: 屏幕上的可见文字会被识别并整理进你的本地知识库;音频只能在「设置 → 录制」里显式打开。

controls.en: This is the product's core data source — without it the capture engine exits instantly and nothing gets recorded.
controls.zh: 这是本产品的核心数据来源——没有这项授权,录制引擎启动后会立刻退出,记不到任何内容。

controls.en: Grant once and the background pipeline reaches your Obsidian vault through the app's stable identity forever — claude/python updates can never trigger new permission prompts again.
controls.zh: 授权一次，后台管线就永远经由 App 的稳定身份读写 Obsidian 笔记库——此后 claude/python 升级不会再弹任何权限窗口。

controls.en: System notifications alert you the moment a new proposal card arrives or a task finishes / needs your input.
controls.zh: 有新提案卡、任务完成或需要你输入时,用系统通知第一时间提醒你。

controls.en: Anonymous usage stats (event metadata only — event names, timings, counts) are on by default to improve the product; the text you type is NOT uploaded by default and is collected only if you opt in below (clipped to 500 chars each).
controls.zh: 匿名使用统计（仅事件元数据，如事件名/耗时/计数）默认开启以改进产品；你输入的文本默认不上传，仅在下方勾选后收集（每条截断 500 字）。

controls.en: Share typed text to improve the product
controls.zh: 分享输入文本以帮助改进产品

controls.en: Settings live only on this Mac; changes take effect immediately.
controls.zh: 设置只存在这台 Mac 上，修改即时生效。

controls.en: Written to state/settings_overrides.json — only keys that differ from config.yaml (highest priority).
controls.zh: 写入 state/settings_overrides.json——只写与 config.yaml 不同的键（优先级最高）。

controls.en: Advanced options (poll intervals, digest schedule, ignored apps, per-directory Obsidian pipeline paths, …) live in config.yaml
controls.zh: 高级选项（轮询间隔、digest 时间、不录制的 App、单独指定 4 个 Obsidian 管线目录等）在 config.yaml 中

controls.en: Currently running from {bundlePath} (a dev build); the login item would point at that temporary path. Run ./build.sh --install first, then enable.
controls.zh: 当前是从 {bundlePath} 运行的开发版；登录项会指向这个临时路径。请先 ./build.sh --install 装到 /Applications 再开启。

controls.en: Failed to enable launch at login
Failed to disable launch at login
Save failed (disk or permissions); this change was not written — change it again to retry:
controls.zh: 保存失败（磁盘或权限问题），这次改动没写入——再改一次即可重试：
请输入不小于 0 的数字，如 5
请输入不小于 0 的数字，如 50

controls.en: Enter a whole number of days, e.g. 60 (0 = never auto-purge)
controls.zh: 请输入整数天数，如 60（0 = 永不自动清）

controls.en: Generating… reads Slack messages you sent recently; this can take a few minutes.
controls.zh: 生成中……会读取你最近发出的 Slack 消息，可能需要几分钟。

controls.en: Generation failed (exit code {code}) with no further output.
controls.zh: 生成失败（退出码 {code}），没有更多输出。

controls.en: Approved cards run inside this folder by default
controls.zh: 批准的卡片默认在这个文件夹里执行

controls.en: ⚠︎ Folder doesn't exist — the first approved card will fail to dispatch.
controls.zh: ⚠︎ 目录不存在——第一张批准的卡会派发失败。
超过此金额需文字确认（USD ≥）

controls.en: Run background tasks without per-action confirmations (faster, default on)
controls.zh: 后台任务免确认执行（更快，默认开）

controls.en: When off, claude's normal permission model applies: sensitive actions park the task in Needs Input until you confirm.
controls.zh: 关掉后走 claude 正常权限模型：敏感操作会把任务挂到「需输入」等你确认。

controls.en: Allow auto-creating private GitHub repos (default off)
controls.zh: 允许自动创建 GitHub 私有仓库（默认关）

controls.en: When on, cards targeting a new repo auto-create a private repo so draft PRs can be delivered; content may originate from your screen/mail, so nothing is pushed by default.
controls.zh: 开启后，新建目标的卡片会自动建私有 repo 以交付 draft PR；内容可能源自屏幕/邮件，默认不外推。

controls.en: No importable Claude Code sessions in the last 7 days — you can also just type a line in the board's input to create a card.
controls.zh: 最近 7 天没有可导入的 Claude Code 会话——在看板输入框写一句话也能直接建卡。

controls.en: Couldn't start the scanner ({error.localizedDescription}) — run a checkup on the Diagnostics page first.
controls.zh: 扫描组件启动失败（{error.localizedDescription}）——先到「诊断」页跑一次体检。

controls.en: The scan didn't run — run a checkup on the Diagnostics page first.
controls.zh: 扫描没跑成——先到「诊断」页跑一次体检。

controls.en: No Claude Code session history found on this Mac (~/.claude/projects) — come back after you've used Claude Code.
controls.zh: 这台 Mac 上没找到 Claude Code 的会话记录（~/.claude/projects）——用过 Claude Code 之后再来导入。

controls.en: The import didn't reach the queue (disk or permission issue) — please click again.
controls.zh: 这次导入没写进队列（磁盘或权限问题）——请再点一次。

controls.en: Submitted {ids.count} — the background service turns them into board cards within seconds (waiting-on-you ones go to Proposals, the rest to Backlog).
controls.zh: 已提交 {ids.count} 条——后台服务几秒内会把它们变成看板卡片（等你回复的进「提案」，其余进「潜在任务」）。

controls.en: Turn your recent Claude Code work into board cards in one click — especially sessions where the AI is still waiting on your reply. Everything stays local; nothing is uploaded.
controls.zh: 把你最近在 Claude Code 里做的事一键变成看板卡片，尤其是 AI 还在等你回复的那些。全程本地，不上传任何内容。
找到 {model.candidates.count} 个会话，其中 {model.waitingCount} 个在等你回复（已默认勾选）

controls.en: The Slack token and Gmail password live in their own sections below (same local storage, same verify-on-save).
controls.zh: Slack token 与 Gmail 密码在下面各自的接入区里粘贴（同样存本机、保存即验证）。

controls.en: Paste, then Save (stored locally; no network)
controls.zh: 粘贴后点保存（只存本机，不联网）

controls.en: Paste, then Save (stored locally; verified on save)
controls.zh: 粘贴后点保存（只存本机，保存即验证）

controls.en: Heads-up: app passwords are usually 16 letters — check you pasted the right thing. Verifying anyway…
controls.zh: 提示：应用密码通常是 16 位字母——检查是否粘贴了别的东西。仍会尝试验证…

controls.en: Saved ✓ (detected legacy App ID + Access Token)
controls.zh: 已保存 ✓（识别为旧版 App ID + Access Token）

controls.en: — click Test for one real server check
controls.zh: ——点「检测」可真连服务器验证一次
先粘贴（或保存）一个凭证再验证

controls.en: Saved, but no Gmail address yet —
controls.zh: 已保存，但还没填 Gmail 地址——

controls.en: fill in "Gmail address" above, then click Verify.
controls.zh: 在上面「Gmail 地址」填好后点「验证」。
检测中（真连一次服务器）…

controls.en: ❌ Key invalid or service not activated ({detail})
❌ Resource not activated ({code}: {message}) — enable streaming ASR in the speech console
controls.zh: ❌ 资源未开通（{code}：{message}）——去语音控制台开通流式语音识别

controls.en: ❌ Model ID not found or not opened ({detail}) — check the translation-model field
controls.zh: ❌ 模型 ID 不存在或未开通（{detail}）——检查「翻译模型」填的 ID

controls.en: ⚠️ Network unreachable ({detail}) — click Test again later
controls.zh: ⚠️ 网络不通（{detail}）——稍后再点「检测」

controls.en: Couldn't verify (network/service) — click Verify again later:
controls.zh: 无法验证（网络/服务问题），稍后点「验证」重试：

controls.en: The token is invalid — regenerate the User OAuth Token at api.slack.com/apps → OAuth & Permissions and paste it again ({raw})
controls.zh: token 无效——到 api.slack.com/apps → OAuth & Permissions 重新生成 User OAuth Token 再粘贴（{raw}）

controls.en: Your company's Google Workspace has disabled this login path ({raw}) — it's a dead end, don't keep trying; mail you read on screen still reaches the system via the recording pipeline.
controls.zh: 你的公司 Google Workspace 禁用了这条登录路（{raw}）——此路不通，不用再试；你读邮件的画面仍会经屏幕录制链进入系统。

controls.en: That's your normal account password — this needs an app password: click "Open Google app passwords" to generate one and paste it ({raw})
controls.zh: 粘贴的是账号普通密码——这里需要的是应用专用密码：点「打开 Google 应用专用密码页」生成一个再粘贴（{raw}）

controls.en: Wrong app password or address — generate a fresh app password and paste it ({raw})
controls.zh: 应用密码或地址不对——重新生成一个应用专用密码再粘贴（{raw}）

controls.en: The key is invalid — regenerate it at console.anthropic.com, then paste and save ({raw})
controls.zh: key 无效——到 console.anthropic.com 重新生成，回来粘贴保存（{raw}）
auto_resume — 后台任务自动拉起

controls.en: Launch at login (recommended: keep the menu-bar assistant resident)
controls.zh: 登录时启动（推荐：菜单栏助手常驻）

controls.en: Uses macOS login items (visible in System Settings → General → Login Items & Extensions).
controls.zh: 走 macOS 登录项（系统设置 → 通用 → 登录项与扩展 可见/可改）。

controls.en: Markup the assistant drafts documents/reports in
controls.zh: 助手起草文档/报告时用哪种标记语言

controls.en: How to alert you when a card reaches review (audible even over a video)
controls.zh: 卡片进「待验收」时怎么提醒你（看视频也能听见）

controls.en: UI-only preference (stored locally); processing placeholders stay pinned atop the Proposals column.
controls.zh: 纯界面偏好（存本机）；提案列顶的处理中占位卡不参与排序。

controls.en: Flight and deal-in animations when cards change lanes or appear (board window only). Auto-disabled by the system Reduce Motion setting; more than 6 changes in one refresh degrade to a crossfade. UI-only preference (stored locally).
controls.zh: 卡片换列/新出现时的飞行与入场动画（仅看板窗口）。跟随系统「减少动态效果」自动停用；一次刷新超过 6 张变化时退化为淡入淡出。纯界面偏好（存本机）。

controls.en: Double-clicking a card's claude command opens and runs it in a new window of this terminal (single click still copies). First use shows the one-time macOS Automation consent for controlling that app. UI-only preference (stored locally).
controls.zh: 双击卡片上的 claude 命令时在这个终端里新开窗口运行（单击仍是复制）。首次使用 macOS 会弹一次「控制该终端」的自动化授权。纯界面偏好（存本机）。

controls.en: See Screen Recording / notes-vault / Notifications grants on one page and fix any gap on the spot.
controls.zh: 屏幕录制 / 笔记库访问 / 通知的授权状态一页看全，缺哪个当场补。

controls.en: Walk through first-run setup again (language / AI engine / permissions / recording / notes / health check): everything prefilled with current values; nothing gets wiped.
controls.zh: 重跑一遍首次设置（语言 / AI 引擎 / 权限 / 录制 / 笔记库 / 健康检查）：全部预填当前值，不会清除任何数据。

controls.en: Check for updates automatically (at most once a day)
controls.zh: 自动检查新版本（每天最多一次）

controls.en: Asks GitHub for the latest version number (api.github.com) — the request exposes only your IP and the current version string, nothing else. A new version shows a low-key note in the menu-bar menu and the About page; nothing is ever downloaded or installed automatically. See docs/TELEMETRY.md.
controls.zh: 向 GitHub 查询最新版本号（api.github.com）——请求只暴露你的 IP 和当前版本号，别无其他。发现新版只在菜单栏菜单与「关于」页低调提示，绝不自动下载安装。详见 docs/TELEMETRY.md。

controls.en: Cleared (falls back to the config.yaml address, if any).
controls.zh: 已清空（改用 config.yaml 里的地址，如果有）。

controls.en: Saved ✓ Paste the app password below and the whole path gets verified automatically.
controls.zh: 已保存 ✓ 在下面粘贴应用专用密码即可自动验证整条链路。

controls.en: Back on path A: the app-password channel (the fetch command is deactivated; its text is kept — switch back to B anytime).
controls.zh: 已切回 A：走应用专用密码通道（抓取命令已停用，命令文本保留着，切回 B 随时恢复）。

controls.en: Fill in the fetch command below and click Save to activate.
controls.zh: 填好下面的抓取命令并点「保存」即生效。

controls.en: Cleared — back on path A (app password).
controls.zh: 已清空——回到 A：应用专用密码通道。

controls.en: Saved ✓ From the next round (≤5 min) the radar fetches mail via this command; see "Run status" below for the truth.
controls.zh: 已保存 ✓ 下一轮（≤5 分钟）起雷达改走这条命令抓邮件；跑没跑成看下面「运行状态」。

controls.en: That email doesn't look right — e.g. you@gmail.com (a Google Workspace address works too)
controls.zh: 邮箱格式不对——例：you@gmail.com（公司 Google Workspace 邮箱也可以）
正在开启并安装后台雷达…
正在关闭并卸载后台雷达…

controls.en: Enabled ✓ The background radar scans unread inbox mail every 5 minutes (read-only — nothing gets marked read). Without a saved password it idles silently.
controls.zh: 已开启 ✓ 后台雷达每 5 分钟扫一次收件箱未读（只读，不会标已读）。没存密码时静默待机。

controls.en: Disabled. The background radar was removed; re-enable anytime.
controls.zh: 已关闭。后台雷达已卸载；随时可以再打开。
正在重新安装后台雷达…

controls.en: Polls unread inbox mail and turns the ones needing you into proposal cards (notifications/marketing filtered out). Read-only — mail is never marked read. Everything is set up right here, no files to edit; changes apply immediately.
controls.zh: 轮询收件箱里的未读邮件，需要你处理的自动变成提案卡（纯通知/营销直接过滤）。只读——邮件绝不会被标成已读。全部在这里配好，不用改任何文件；此区改动即时生效。
A · 应用专用密码（推荐）

controls.en: Use B when a Workspace admin has disabled app passwords — the radar periodically runs your own command to fetch mail; triage downstream is identical.
controls.zh: 公司 Workspace 禁用了应用专用密码时走 B——雷达定时调你自己的命令去抓邮件，抓回来的分诊完全相同。

controls.en: The radar executes it directly each round (no shell). $GMAIL_RADAR_LAST_UID carries the progress marker; the command prints a JSON array to stdout: {uid (monotonic), from, subject, date, message_id, body}. A Gmail-API script or an MCP client both qualify.
controls.zh: 雷达每轮直接执行它（不走 shell），环境变量 GMAIL_RADAR_LAST_UID 带上次进度，命令在 stdout 打印一个 JSON 数组：{uid（单调递增）, from, subject, date, message_id, body}。Gmail API 脚本、MCP 客户端都可以。

controls.en: ① Generate an app password (one-time, ~1 min)
controls.zh: ① 生成应用专用密码（一次性，~1 分钟）

controls.en: Requires 2-Step Verification on the account. On the page, any app name works (e.g. Zelin AI Assistant) → Create → Google shows a 16-letter password (only once) — copy it.
controls.zh: 要求账号已开两步验证。页面里 App name 随便填（如 Zelin AI Assistant）→ 创建 → Google 显示 16 位密码（只显示这一次），复制它。
打开 Google 应用专用密码页

controls.en: Company Google Workspace: if the page says "The setting you are looking for is not available for your account", the admin has disabled app passwords — this path is closed, don't keep trying; mail you read on screen still reaches the system via the recording pipeline.
controls.zh: 公司 Google Workspace：页面若显示 “The setting you are looking for is not available for your account”，是管理员禁用了应用专用密码——此路不通，不用再试；你读邮件的画面仍会经屏幕录制链进入系统。

controls.en: ③ Paste the password (spaces auto-stripped; a real login verifies it on save)
controls.zh: ③ 粘贴密码（自动去空格，保存即真实验证）
已安装，每 5 分钟自动运行
运行状态（真实轮询结果）

controls.en: No runs recorded yet. Wait one round (≤5 min) or click "Test one round now".
controls.zh: 还没有运行记录。等一轮（≤5 分钟）或点「立即测试一轮」。
运行正常 ✓ 最近成功

controls.en: The toggle was still off during the last round — click "Test one round now"
controls.zh: 上一轮运行时开关还没打开——点「立即测试一轮」再看

controls.en: No app password saved yet — finish steps ①/③ above
controls.zh: 还没保存应用专用密码——完成上面第 ①/③ 步

controls.en: No Gmail address yet — fill in step ② above and Save
controls.zh: 还没填 Gmail 地址——在上面第 ② 步填好并保存

controls.en: Wrong app password or address — generate a fresh app password and paste it (a Workspace admin having disabled app passwords looks the same; see the note above)
controls.zh: 应用密码或地址不对——重新生成一个应用专用密码再粘贴（公司 Workspace 禁用应用密码时也会这样，见上方说明）

controls.en: Can't reach Gmail (network trouble) — click "Test one round now" again later
controls.zh: 连不上 Gmail（网络问题）——稍后点「立即测试一轮」重试

controls.en: The fetch command failed (error/timeout) — run it by hand in a terminal to see why
controls.zh: 抓取命令没跑成（fetch_command 报错/超时）——在终端手动跑一次它看报错

controls.en: The fetch command didn't print a JSON array — check its output format
controls.zh: 抓取命令的输出不是 JSON 数组——检查 fetch_command 的输出格式

controls.en: Lyrics-style always-on-top captions: live transcription of the microphone and/or system audio. Also toggleable from the menu-bar Recording menu.
controls.zh: 歌词式置顶字幕：实时转写麦克风和/或系统声音。也可以从菜单栏「录制」菜单开关。

controls.en: — click ▶ on the overlay to resume
System audio rides the Screen Recording grant (the recording engine already uses it); the mic prompts for permission on first enable.
controls.zh: 系统声音走「屏幕录制」权限（录制引擎已经用它）；麦克风首次开启时会弹系统授权。
本地识别语言（仅 Apple 引擎）

controls.en: The Doubao engine code-switches zh/en automatically — no choice needed.
controls.zh: 豆包引擎自动中英混识，无需选择。

controls.en: Two formats work: the new-console API key, or the legacy App ID + Access Token — most reliable as one "AppID:Token" line (labels like "App ID:" / "Access Token:" are recognized too); pasting the two lines usually works as well (depends on the paste keeping the line break).
controls.zh: 支持两种：新版控制台的 API Key，或旧版的 App ID + Access Token——最稳是粘成一行 "AppID:Token"（带 "App ID:"、"Access Token:" 等标签也认）；直接粘两行通常也行（取决于粘贴时换行是否保留）。

controls.en: Ark API key (translation — a different key)
controls.zh: Ark API Key（翻译用，另一个 Key）

controls.en: The two credentials come from two different Volcano consoles: the speech credential does recognition, the Ark key does translation. Both live only in local config/secrets/, read only by the app itself (never by Python/cron), and take effect when captions start. Saving stores locally without any network call; clicking Test makes one real connection to the matching server.
controls.zh: 两个凭证来自火山引擎的两个不同控制台：语音凭证管识别，Ark Key 管翻译。都只存本机 config/secrets/，只有 App 自己读（Python/cron 永不读取），保存后在开启字幕时生效。保存只存本机、不联网；点「检测」才真连一次对应服务器验证。

controls.en: Translate captions (needs the Ark key + Doubao engine)
controls.zh: 翻译字幕（需要 Ark Key + 豆包引擎）

controls.en: Costs (all on your own account): Doubao streaming ASR ≈ ¥1/hour with 20 free hours after personal sign-up; translation via doubao-seed flash usually costs under ¥0.1 per captioned hour, and Ark grants 500k free tokens per model. The Apple on-device engine is fully free and offline (macOS 26+). Caption text never leaves this Mac except to your own recognition/translation endpoints, and never appears in this product's anonymous telemetry.
controls.zh: 费用（都是你自己的账号）：豆包流式识别约 ¥1/小时，个人实名开通即送 20 小时；翻译走 doubao-seed flash，一小时字幕的翻译费通常不到 ¥0.1，Ark 每个模型另送 50 万 token。Apple 本地引擎完全免费离线（需 macOS 26+）。字幕文本永不离开这台 Mac，只发往你自己开通的识别/翻译服务；本产品的匿名统计里也永远没有字幕内容。

controls.en: Auto = Doubao when a key is saved (better zh/en mixing and punctuation), otherwise Apple on-device (free, offline).
controls.zh: 自动 = 有豆包 Key 就用豆包（中英混识、标点更好），否则用 Apple 本地（免费离线）。

controls.en: Auto = Doubao when a key is saved. This Mac is below macOS 26, so Apple on-device recognition is unavailable.
controls.zh: 自动 = 有豆包 Key 就用豆包。这台 Mac 低于 macOS 26，没有 Apple 本地识别可用。

controls.en: Cleared — the default repo folder is used.
controls.zh: 已清空——使用默认仓库目录。

controls.en: Saved, but that path doesn't exist right now — the button stays disabled until it does.
controls.zh: 已保存，但这个路径现在不存在——按钮会一直禁用，直到路径有效。

controls.en: A session id may not start with a hyphen (-) — that's the shape of a command-line flag, not a session id.
controls.zh: 会话 ID 不能以连字符（-）开头——那是命令行选项的形状，不是会话 ID。

controls.en: A session id may only contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-) — the id you copy from claude is exactly that shape.
controls.zh: 会话 ID 只能包含字母、数字和连字符（-）——从 claude 里复制的会话 ID 就是这个样子。

controls.en: Saved ✓ The button resumes this session with --resume.
controls.zh: 已保存 ✓ 按钮会用 --resume 接着这个会话聊。

controls.en: Cleared — the button starts a fresh session each time.
controls.zh: 已清空——按钮每次开一个全新会话。

controls.en: Cleared — the button uses the session id from config.yaml (the greyed-out one).
controls.zh: 已清空——按钮用 config.yaml 里的会话 ID（灰字）。

controls.en: That path doesn't exist — set an existing repo folder above first.
controls.zh: 路径不存在——先在上面填一个存在的仓库目录。

controls.en: Opened in the terminal ✓ — just tell it what to fix or change.
controls.zh: 已在终端打开 ✓ 直接告诉它要修什么、改什么就行。

controls.en: Couldn't open the terminal — check the terminal app under General, or run this by hand: {cmd}
controls.zh: 打开终端失败——去「通用」检查终端应用设置，或手动在终端运行：{cmd}

controls.en: A full Claude development session over this software's own source: fix bugs, add features, run tests, open PRs — the button below opens it in a terminal; just say what you want, in plain language.
controls.zh: 这是一个对着本软件源码的全功能 Claude 开发会话：修 bug、加功能、跑测试、提 PR 都可以——点下面的按钮在终端打开，直接用中文告诉它你想要什么。
代码仓库目录（留空 = 默认）

controls.en: The greyed-out path is the current default (config.yaml's maintainer.repo_path, else this software's own repo); only developers with a clone elsewhere need to change it.
controls.zh: 灰字是当前默认（config.yaml 的 maintainer.repo_path，否则本软件自己的仓库）；只有开发者克隆到别处时才需要改。

controls.en: Session id (optional; empty = a fresh session each time)
controls.zh: 会话 ID（可选，留空 = 每次全新会话）

controls.en: With an id set, the button resumes that same session via --resume — handy for continuing a fix that didn't finish in one sitting.
controls.zh: 填上后按钮会用 --resume 回到同一个会话——适合把一次没修完的问题接着聊。

controls.en: Open a development session in the terminal
Opens in {TerminalLauncher.preferred.displayName} (change the terminal app under General).
controls.zh: 会在 {TerminalLauncher.preferred.displayName} 中打开（终端应用在「通用」里换）。

controls.en: File not found — no MCP servers configured in this scope yet.
controls.zh: 文件不存在——这个作用域还没配置过 MCP server。

controls.en: Couldn't parse the JSON — click "Reveal in Finder" and check the syntax in an editor.
controls.zh: JSON 解析失败——点「在 Finder 显示」用编辑器检查语法。

controls.en: No mcpServers entry in the file yet.
controls.zh: 文件里还没有 mcpServers 条目。

controls.en: MCP servers are external tool servers Claude Code can call — if a skill is a recipe, an MCP server is a plug-in kitchen appliance (databases, browsers, Slack and the like). This list covers the user and project scopes (the CLI's default local scope is not shown here). It is read-only; add or remove servers with `claude mcp add` / `claude mcp remove` in a terminal, or edit the config files directly.
controls.zh: MCP server 是 Claude Code 能调用的外接工具服务器——如果说 skill 是菜谱，MCP 就是外接厨具（数据库、浏览器、Slack 这类能力）。本列表显示 user 与 project 两个作用域（CLI 默认的 local 作用域不在此列）。这里只读展示，增删改在终端用 `claude mcp add` / `claude mcp remove`，或直接编辑配置文件。
共 {model.servers.count} 个 server（用户 {model.count(in: .user}) · 项目 {model.count(in: .project})）

controls.en: No MCP servers in either scope yet. Add one in a terminal, then come back and hit Refresh:
controls.zh: 两个作用域都还没有 MCP server。到终端里加一个，回来点「刷新」就能看到：

controls.en: Env vars show as a count only — values may hold secrets and are never displayed.
controls.zh: 环境变量只显示数量——值可能含密钥，绝不显示。
显示菜单栏图标（主图标：卡片列表）

controls.en: With the main icon hidden, the main window still opens from the Dock / by reopening the app.
controls.zh: 隐藏主图标后，主窗口仍可从 Dock / 再次打开 App 唤起。

controls.en: Notes live here; the radar scans it for asks
controls.zh: 笔记存这里，雷达也从这里发现待办

controls.en: ⚠︎ The vault folder doesn't exist yet — pick one with Choose…, or create it now.
controls.zh: ⚠︎ 笔记库目录还不存在——点「选择…」挑一个，或一键创建。

controls.en: ⚙︎ Some pipeline folders are customized in config.yaml and don't follow this vault root — config.yaml wins.
controls.zh: ⚙︎ 部分管线目录已在 config.yaml 自定义，不跟随这里的 vault 根目录——以 config.yaml 为准。

controls.en: Four standard subfolders inside the vault are used (and created) automatically: 1 - unprocessed (capture exports) · 2 - raw (radar scan source) · 3 - change-summary (change logs) · 4 - wiki (knowledge base). Default: ~/Documents/Obsidian Vault.
controls.zh: vault 内自动使用并创建 4 个标准子目录：1 - unprocessed（截图/录音落点）· 2 - raw（雷达扫描源）· 3 - change-summary（变更日志）· 4 - wiki（知识库）。默认 ~/Documents/Obsidian Vault。

controls.en: On app launch, Screenpipe recording starts automatically in this mode.
controls.zh: 打开 App 时自动按此模式启动 Screenpipe 持续录制。

controls.en: Enable term-list redaction — replace term-list matches with [REDACTED] before sending prompts
controls.zh: 启用词表脱敏 — 发出 prompt 前把词表词条替换成 [脱敏]

controls.en: Secrets masking — built-in regexes (sk-ant-/xox*/AKIA/gh*_/PEM), always on regardless of the toggle above
controls.zh: 密钥掩码 — 内置正则 (sk-ant-/xox*/AKIA/gh*_/PEM)，始终生效，不依赖词表开关

controls.en: Terms file (one per line, re: prefix = regex)
controls.zh: 词表文件（一行一条，re: 前缀=正则）

controls.en: Secrets masking is on by default; term-list redaction is off by default (enabling changes what the AI sees). Local originals are unaffected.
controls.zh: 密钥掩码默认开启；词表脱敏默认关闭（打开会改变 AI 看到的内容）。本地存的原文不受影响。

controls.en: Name must be kebab-case: lowercase letters/digits joined by - (e.g. my-skill)
controls.zh: 名称须是 kebab-case：小写字母/数字，用 - 连接（例：my-skill）

controls.en: A skill named {name} already exists — not overwriting. Edit it via "Reveal in Finder", or pick another name.
controls.zh: 已有同名 skill（{name}）——不覆盖。用「在 Finder 显示」直接改它，或换个名字。

controls.en: Created ✓ ~/.claude/skills/{name}/SKILL.md — available to Claude Code from its next session; edit it via "Reveal in Finder".
controls.zh: 已创建 ✓ ~/.claude/skills/{name}/SKILL.md——Claude Code 下次会话即可用；要改内容用「在 Finder 显示」。

controls.en: A skill is a reusable instruction pack for Claude Code (a folder + SKILL.md). Both scopes are listed: user-level ~/.claude/skills/ applies everywhere, project-level <repo>/.claude/skills/ applies to this repo only. This panel lists and creates; to edit, use "Reveal in Finder" and change the file.
controls.zh: Skill 是给 Claude Code 的可复用指令包（一个文件夹 + SKILL.md）。这里汇总两个作用域：用户级 ~/.claude/skills/ 对所有项目生效，项目级 <仓库>/.claude/skills/ 只对本仓库生效。此处只看和新建；改内容用「在 Finder 显示」直接编辑文件。
共 {model.skills.count} 个（用户级 {model.userCount} · 项目级 {model.projectCount}）

controls.en: No skills yet — click "New skill" above to create your first, or drop an existing skill folder into ~/.claude/skills/ and hit Refresh.
controls.zh: 还没有任何 skill——点上面「新建 skill」创建第一个，或把现成的 skill 文件夹放进 ~/.claude/skills/ 再点「刷新」。
新建 skill（保存到 ~/.claude/skills/，用户级）

controls.en: One-line description (Claude uses it to decide when to activate the skill)
controls.zh: 一句话描述（Claude 靠它决定何时启用这个 skill）

controls.en: Missing {path} — incomplete repo? Reinstall to fix.
controls.zh: 找不到 {path}——repo 不完整？重装一次即可。

controls.en: That's a Bot token (xoxb-) — reading your DMs needs the User OAuth Token (starts with xoxp-, in the User section of OAuth & Permissions).
controls.zh: 这是 Bot token（xoxb-）——雷达读你的 DM 需要 User OAuth Token（xoxp- 开头，在 OAuth & Permissions 页的 User 区）。

controls.en: Heads-up: User OAuth Tokens usually start with xoxp- — double-check the copy. Verifying anyway…
controls.zh: 提示：User OAuth Token 通常以 xoxp- 开头——检查是否复制对了。仍会尝试验证…

controls.en: Paste and save a token first
controls.zh: 先粘贴并保存 token 再验证

controls.en: Verified ✓ Connected to {team}; identity @{user} filled in automatically — no files to edit.
controls.zh: 已验证 ✓ 已连接 {team}，身份 @{user} 自动填好——不用再改任何文件。

controls.en: Verification failed: the token is invalid — copy the User OAuth Token again at api.slack.com/apps → OAuth & Permissions and paste it ({code})
controls.zh: 验证失败：token 无效——到 api.slack.com/apps → OAuth & Permissions 重新复制 User OAuth Token 再粘贴（{code}）

controls.en: Couldn't verify (network/service) — click Verify again later:
controls.zh: 无法验证（网络/服务问题），稍后点「验证」重试：

controls.en: Couldn't read the Slack directory — try again later
controls.zh: 读取 Slack 目录失败——稍后重试
正在开启并安装后台雷达…
正在关闭并卸载后台雷达…

controls.en: Enabled ✓ The background radar checks DMs / groups / @mentions every 3 minutes. Without a token it falls back to read-only MCP scanning or idles silently.
controls.zh: 已开启 ✓ 后台雷达每 3 分钟看一次 DM / 群 / @提及。没保存 token 时走 MCP 只读兜底或静默待机。

controls.en: Disabled. The background radar was removed; re-enable anytime.
controls.zh: 已关闭。后台雷达已卸载；随时可以再打开。
正在重新安装后台雷达…

controls.en: Turns "people needing you on Slack" (DMs / groups / @mentions) into proposal cards automatically. All 3 setup steps happen right here — no files to edit; outbound replies are drafts only, you always send them yourself. Changes apply immediately.
controls.zh: 把「别人在 Slack 上找你的事」（DM / 群 / @提及）自动变成提案卡。3 步全在这里完成，不用改任何文件；对外只出草稿，永远你自己发。此区改动即时生效。

controls.en: ① Create the Slack app (one paste; scopes preconfigured)
controls.zh: ① 建 Slack app（一次粘贴，权限已配好）

controls.en: Open api.slack.com/apps → Create New App → From a manifest → pick your workspace → switch the dialog to the JSON tab → paste what you copied → Create.
controls.zh: 打开 api.slack.com/apps → Create New App → From a manifest → 选你的 workspace → 对话框切到 JSON 标签页 → 粘贴刚复制的内容 → Create。

controls.en: Click Install to Workspace at the top → authorize. Then open OAuth & Permissions (left sidebar) and copy the User OAuth Token (starts with xoxp-, NOT the xoxb- bot token). If your company requires admin approval, do step ③ once it's granted — meanwhile the radar falls back to read-only MCP scanning instead of waiting idle.
controls.zh: 页面顶部 Install to Workspace → 授权。装好后到左侧 OAuth & Permissions，复制 User OAuth Token（xoxp- 开头；不是 xoxb- 的 Bot token）。公司要求管理员审批的话，等批下来再做第 ③ 步——期间雷达会用只读 MCP 兜底扫描，不会干等。

controls.en: ③ Paste the token (verified on save; identity auto-filled)
controls.zh: ③ 粘贴 token（保存即验证，身份自动填好）

controls.en: DMs and group DMs are always watched (a DM usually needs you). Channels: only the ones you check here, and only when you're @mentioned; the first "watched person" is treated as your manager (for meeting-note detection). Until you change something here, config.yaml stays in charge.
controls.zh: DM 和群消息总是全看（有人私你 = 大概率要处理）。频道只看你勾选的这些、且 @你 才建卡；「关注的人」的第一位按你的 manager 处理（会议纪要识别用）。这里没改过时沿用 config.yaml 的配置。
关注的人（第一位 = 你的 manager）

controls.en: {filtered.count - shown.count} more — narrow it down with the filter above
controls.zh: 还有 {filtered.count - shown.count} 项——用上面的筛选框缩小范围
已安装，每 3 分钟自动运行
运行状态（真实轮询结果）

controls.en: No runs recorded yet. Wait one round (≤3 min) or click "Test one round now".
controls.zh: 还没有运行记录。等一轮（≤3 分钟）或点「立即测试一轮」。
运行正常 ✓ 最近成功

controls.en: The MCP fallback scan failed (the native path takes over once a token is saved): {r}
controls.zh: MCP 兜底扫描失败（token 批下来后自动改走正式通道）：{r}

controls.en: The toggle was still off during the last round — click "Test one round now"
controls.zh: 上一轮运行时开关还没打开——点「立即测试一轮」再看

controls.en: No token saved yet — finish step ③ above (while awaiting admin approval the MCP fallback covers you)
controls.zh: 还没保存 token——完成上面第 ③ 步（等管理员审批时会走 MCP 兜底）

controls.en: Token invalid or Slack unreachable — click Verify above for the exact reason
controls.zh: token 无效或连不上 Slack——点上面「验证」看具体原因

controls.en: Turning on sync and generating the pairing QR…
controls.zh: 正在开启同步并生成配对二维码…
正在重新生成配对二维码…

controls.en: Updating the device name and refreshing the QR…
controls.zh: 正在更新设备名并刷新二维码…

controls.en: Device name updated ✓ The QR has been refreshed too.
controls.zh: 设备名已更新 ✓ 二维码已同步刷新。

controls.en: On ✓ Scan the code below from your phone to pair.
controls.zh: 已开启 ✓ 用手机扫下面的码即可配对。

controls.en: On (channel registration retries automatically once online) — the QR is ready to scan now.
controls.zh: 已开启（频道注册会在联网后自动重试）——二维码现在就能扫。

controls.en: Off. The keys stay on this Mac; re-enable anytime — no re-pairing needed.
controls.zh: 已关闭。密钥保留在本机,随时可以再打开——不用重新配对。

controls.en: Couldn't turn it off — try again later.
No usable python — set up the runtime first in General · Setup wizard.
controls.zh: 找不到可用的 python——先在「通用 · 权限体检 / 初始设置向导」里装好运行环境。

controls.en: Pairing failed — check your network and retry (see state/syncd.log).
controls.zh: 配对失败——请检查网络后重试（或看 state/syncd.log）。

controls.en: Sync this Mac's board to your phone so you can view it and approve remotely. Turning it on generates a pairing QR — scan it once in the phone app. Card bodies are end-to-end encrypted; neither the server nor the maintainer can read them. Changes apply immediately.
controls.zh: 把这台 Mac 的看板同步到手机,就能在手机上查看、远程审批。开启后生成一个配对二维码——在手机 App 里扫一次即可。卡片正文端到端加密,服务器和维护者都读不到明文。此区改动即时生效。

controls.en: Scan this in the phone app to pair (once per Mac).
controls.zh: 在手机 App 里扫这个码配对（每台 Mac 扫一次）

controls.en: This name shows in the phone app. A rename goes into the QR immediately; already-paired phones pick up the new name on their next board refresh — no re-scan needed.
controls.zh: 这个名字会显示在手机 App 里。改名立即进二维码;已配对的手机在下一次刷新看板时自动更新名字,不用重新扫码。

controls.en: ⚠️ This QR is the master key — anyone who scans it can read your board and act on your behalf. Don't share screenshots or post it anywhere public.
controls.zh: ⚠️ 这个二维码就是主密钥——谁扫到就能看你的看板、还能替你操作。别截图群发、别贴到公开的地方。

controls.en: Product improvement (on by default; event metadata only — typed text needs the separate opt-in below)
controls.zh: 参与产品改进（默认开，仅事件元数据——输入文本需在下方单独勾选）

controls.en: Both Basic and Detailed send anonymous event metadata — event name, time, page/action, timing counts, random device id, app version. Switching to Basic also stops the typed-text upload below (text requires Detailed).
controls.zh: 基础与详细都发送匿名事件元数据——事件名、时间、页面/动作、耗时计数、随机设备号、版本号。切到基础还会同时停掉下方的输入文本上传（文本需要详细级）。

controls.en: Upload the text I type, to know me better (off by default — checking is opting in: captures, questions, rework feedback, search terms; ≤500 chars each)
controls.zh: 上传我输入的文本以更懂我（默认关，勾选即同意：快速捕获、提问、打回反馈、搜索词；每条 ≤500 字符）

controls.en: Collects only what you personally type into this app (truncated to 500 chars, built-in key masking) — never the AI's answers, screen-recording content, emails or Slack messages. Turning this off stops recording and uploading new text (a few lines recorded before the switch-off may still upload with behavior stats); behavior stats are unaffected.
controls.zh: 只收集你亲手输入进本 App 的文字（截断 500 字符，内置密钥掩码）——绝不含 AI 的回答、屏幕录制内容、邮件或 Slack 消息。关掉此开关即停止记录与上传新的文本（关前已记录、尚未上传的少量行仍会随行为统计发出），行为统计不受影响。

controls.en: Turning the top toggle off stops all uploads entirely; the local stats file is unaffected. See docs/TELEMETRY.md.
controls.zh: 关掉最上方开关即完全停止全部上传；本地统计文件不受影响。详见 docs/TELEMETRY.md。

controls.en: Text drafted in your name (Slack replies, email bodies, …) first reads this profile to match how you write. Your private profile stays local in state/ and is never committed.
controls.zh: 以你的名义起草的文字（Slack 回复、邮件正文等）会先读这份档案来模仿你的说话风格。私有档案只存本机 state/，永不进 git。

controls.en: When off, background tasks run as usual — drafted text just stops imitating your voice.
controls.zh: 关掉后后台任务照常运行，只是起草的文字不再模仿你的口吻。
从我的消息生成/更新档案

controls.en: Requires the Slack connection; the existing profile is backed up automatically before generating.
controls.zh: 需要 Slack 连接；生成前会自动备份现有档案。

controls.en: Auto-generate a weekly "what you were up to" recap (default off)
controls.zh: 每周自动生成「本周你都在忙什么」回顾卡（默认关）

controls.en: Reads the last 7 days of ingest notes: the recap lands in the Review lane. Skips (free) when there is no new data. (Automation-idea cards are retired.)
controls.zh: 读取最近 7 天的 ingest 笔记：摘要卡片会出现在「待验收」。没有新数据时会自动跳过，不花钱。（自动化建议卡已退役。）

controls.en: Changes in this section apply immediately — no Save needed.
controls.zh: 本区改动即时生效，不用点下方的保存。

controls.en: Requested — you'll get a notification; the recap appears in the Review lane.
controls.zh: 已请求生成——完成后会弹通知，摘要出现在「待验收」。

controls.en: Could not write the request (disk issue) — try again:
controls.zh: 没能写入请求（磁盘问题），请再点一次：

controls.en: Background-service template missing ({template}) — incomplete repo? Running bash install.sh in the repo directory fixes it
controls.zh: 后台服务模板缺失({template})——repo 不完整?在 repo 目录运行 bash install.sh 可修复
欢迎使用 Zelin's AI Assistant

controls.en: Your personal AI secretary: it captures your screen, finds what people ask of you in mail and messages, and turns it into proposal cards; you approve and accept — the AI does the rest.
controls.zh: 你的个人 AI 秘书:它记录你的屏幕、从邮件和消息里发现别人拜托你的事,整理成提案卡片;你只需要批准和验收,其余交给 AI。

controls.en: The next few steps (about 2 minutes) set everything up. Every option is prefilled from what was detected — clicking Next all the way through yields a working system, and everything stays changeable in Settings.
controls.zh: 接下来几步(约 2 分钟)把系统配好。所有选项都已按检测结果预填——一路点「下一步」就能得到一套能用的系统,之后随时可在设置里修改。

controls.en: Preselected from your system language; changeable anytime in Settings.
controls.zh: 已按系统语言预选;随时可在 设置 里更改。

controls.en: Approved cards are executed by the claude CLI in the background. This step detects your existing setup — most people need to do nothing.
controls.zh: 批准的卡片由 claude CLI 在后台执行。这里检测你已有的配置——多数人无需任何操作。

controls.en: Detecting the claude CLI and its login…
controls.zh: 正在检测 claude CLI 与登录状态…

controls.en: Without an AI engine, proposals will never be executed. Connect with either option below (A recommended):
controls.zh: 没有 AI 引擎,提案永远不会被执行。选择下面任一方式接入(推荐 A):

controls.en: A. Use your Claude Code login (recommended)
controls.zh: A. 使用 Claude Code 现有登录(推荐)

controls.en: The claude command wasn't found. Install Claude Code, log in once, then click Re-detect.
controls.zh: 还没找到 claude 命令。安装 Claude Code,登录一次,然后点「重新检测」。

controls.en: The claude CLI is installed but not logged in. Run claude in Terminal, follow the login prompt, then click Re-detect.
controls.zh: 已找到 claude CLI,但还没有登录。在终端运行 claude 按提示登录,回来点「重新检测」。

controls.en: B. Paste an Anthropic API key
controls.zh: B. 粘贴 Anthropic API key

controls.en: Generate a key in the console and paste it here — it verifies on paste (one free connectivity check, no tokens billed) and is saved only when valid (local only, mode 0600).
controls.zh: 从控制台生成一个 key 粘贴到这里——粘贴后自动验证(一次免费的连通性检查,不消耗 tokens),有效才保存(仅存本机,权限 0600)。

controls.en: Skipping now is fine too — add it anytime later in Settings → Credentials.
controls.zh: 现在跳过也可以——之后在 设置 → 凭证 里随时补上。

controls.en: ❌ Invalid key — regenerate one in the console and paste again
controls.zh: ❌ key 无效——请到控制台重新生成一个,回来再粘贴

controls.en: Couldn't verify right now (network): {why} — click Save to store it and re-verify later in Settings → Credentials
controls.zh: 暂时无法验证(网络问题): {why}——可点「保存」先存下,稍后在 设置 → 凭证 里再验证

controls.en: Saved (unverified) — you can Verify later in Settings → Credentials
controls.zh: 已保存(未验证)——之后可在 设置 → 凭证 里点「验证」

controls.en: These system switches are the only things macOS requires you to click yourself. Statuses refresh live — rows turn green as you grant them.
controls.zh: 需要用户亲手点的只有这几个系统开关。状态实时刷新——授权完成会自动变绿。

controls.en: This is the assistant's core data source. See what is captured, where it goes and how long it stays — then decide.
controls.zh: 这是助手的核心数据来源。先看清楚采集什么、去哪里、留多久,再决定。

controls.en: Distilled notes live here, and the radar scans it for asks. Obsidian vaults found on this Mac are listed — not using Obsidian is perfectly fine.
controls.zh: 屏幕记录提炼出的笔记存在这里,雷达也从这里发现待办。检测到的 Obsidian vault 已列出——不用 Obsidian 也完全没问题。
不用 Obsidian — 存成普通 Markdown 文件夹

controls.en: Four standard subfolders are created inside (1 - unprocessed / 2 - raw / 3 - change-summary / 4 - wiki); changeable later in Settings → Obsidian Vault location.
controls.zh: 会在所选位置自动创建 4 个标准子目录(1 - unprocessed / 2 - raw / 3 - change-summary / 4 - wiki);之后可在 设置 → Obsidian Vault 位置 修改。

controls.en: Save failed (disk or permissions); this location was not applied — pick another or fix it, then click Next again:
controls.zh: 保存失败（磁盘或权限问题），这个位置没有生效——换一个位置或修复后再点「下一步」：

controls.en: Confirming the system actually runs. Every red row has one fix button — go until it's all green.
controls.zh: 逐项确认系统真的能跑起来。红色的行都带一个修复按钮——绿完为止。
